title: The Thirteen Rings
rumor: The Thirteen Rings. An enormous fallen tree lies somewhere beyond the logging camps, its trunk bearing only thirteen growth rings despite being larger than any tree in the surrounding forest. Each ring contains intricate patterns resembling writing. One woodcutter who attempted to remove a section of the trunk returned with his hair turned completely white.
first_lead: The tale is often repeated at the Split Stag, where several lumbermen claim to have seen the tree.
